{
  "topic": "Behavior of llama.cpp's HTTP server file-upload button in prompt handling",
  "audience": "local LLM enthusiasts",
  "problem_or_goal": "Understanding how the file-upload button affects prompt processing and response consistency",
  "context": "An archived user inquiry from May 2025 about llama.cpp version 3.2 3B Q4_K_S's HTTP server file-upload feature and its interaction with user prompts",
  "motivation": "Clarifying whether the file-upload button concatenates file content with user prompts and how that impacts answer reliability and reproducibility",
  "desired_response": "An explanation of the file-upload button's function in prompt construction and guidance on achieving consistent query results about file contents",
  "speaker_relationship_to_source": "reader of archived source; no claim of personally running reported tests",
  "facts": [
    {
      "id": "F1",
      "text": "The user suspects the file-upload button concatenates the file content with the direct prompt.",
      "evidence_quote": "Does it simply concatenate the file and my direct prompt, treating the concatenation as the prompt?",
      "status": "source-author report, not independently verified measurement"
    },
    {
      "id": "F2",
      "text": "The user notes that no model would yield reliable results if the above concatenation is true.",
      "evidence_quote": "but incase my above suspicion is true, that does not matter as no model would yield reliable results.",
      "status": "source-author report, not independently verified measurement"
    },
    {
      "id": "F3",
      "text": "In 15 experiments, the user sometimes got correct answers about the file's contents.",
      "evidence_quote": "In my 15 experiments, sometimes the question about the file's contents is correctly answered.",
      "status": "source-author report, not independently verified measurement"
    },
    {
      "id": "F4",
      "text": "Sometimes the model interprets the file contents instead of the user's query.",
      "evidence_quote": "But sometimes it interprets the contents of the file instead of my query.",
      "status": "source-author report, not independently verified measurement"
    },
    {
      "id": "F5",
      "text": "The user desires reproducible results when reopening conversations with the same prompts.",
      "evidence_quote": "I would like the result to be reproducable, ie when I open a new conversation, giving it the same prompts, I would like to get the same answers",
      "status": "source-author report, not independently verified measurement"
    }
  ],
  "allowed_claims": [
    "The file-upload button may concatenate file content with the prompt.",
    "Model responses can vary between interpreting file content and user queries.",
    "Reproducibility of answers is a concern when using file uploads in prompts."
  ],
  "forbidden_claims": [
    "Any specific performance metrics or success rates.",
    "Claims about hardware or model architecture beyond the stated version.",
    "Assumptions about user motivations beyond those expressed."
  ],
  "essential_limitations": [
    "Uncertainty about the exact internal handling of file uploads by llama.cpp's HTTP server.",
    "No independent verification of the user's experimental results.",
    "Unknown settings or parameters used during the experiments."
  ],
  "missing_information": [
    "Precise mechanism of how the file-upload button integrates file content into the prompt.",
    "Whether any prompt preprocessing or tokenization affects the concatenation.",
    "Details on model configuration or session state management affecting reproducibility."
  ]
}
